macros.name: Rcmd
macros.doc: This command will be passed to R to be executed.

macros.name: Rset
macros.doc: This command will set the specified variable equal to the specified expression.

macros.name: Rtable
macros.doc: This command produces the body of a LaTeX formatted table using the given values.

macros.name: Rvalue
macros.doc: This command will instruct R to evaluate the expression, round the result to the specified number of significant figures (default is 4), and display the result inline in your document.
